# 🚀 Z-Image Setup & Downloads

### 🏠 Official Repository & Direct Links
* **Comfy-Org HuggingFace:** [Browse All Models](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org)
* **Z-Image Turbo Checkpoint:** [z_image_turbo_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/z_image_turbo/resolve/main/split_files/diffusion_models/z_image_turbo_bf16.safetensors)
* **Z-Image Standard Checkpoint:** [z_image_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/z_image/resolve/main/split_files/diffusion_models/z_image_bf16.safetensors)
* **Quantized Alternatives:** [Kijai on HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/Kijai) (For E4M3/E5M2 versions)

### 🔡 Text Encoders (Qwen 3.4B)
* **Standard (BF16):** [qwen_3_4b.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/z_image_turbo/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/qwen_3_4b.safetensors)
* **Optimized (FP8 Mixed):** [qwen_3_4b_fp8_mixed.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/z_image/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/qwen_3_4b_fp8_mixed.safetensors)
* **Ultra Low (FP4 Mixed):** [qwen_3_4b_fp4_mixed.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/z_image/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/qwen_3_4b_fp4_mixed.safetensors)

### 🧬 VAE
* **Autoencoder:** [ae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/z_image_turbo/resolve/main/split_files/vae/ae.safetensors)

---

## 📂 Model Storage Location
Place files in: **ComfyUI/models/**
* **text_encoders/** -> qwen_3_4b... 
* **diffusion_models/** -> z_image_turbo_bf16... or z_image_bf16...
* **vae/** -> ae.safetensors

---

## ⚙️ Recommended Settings

| Setting | Value (Turbo Model) | Value (Standard Model) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Sampler** | **res_multistep** / dpmpp_2m | **res_multistep** / dpmpp_sde |
| **Steps** | 4 - 8 Steps | 25 - 55 Steps |
| **CFG Scale** | 1.0 (here auto)| 3.0 - 7.5 use my extra workflow|
| **Scheduler** | sgm_uniform | simple / normal |

---

## 🔬 Advanced: FP8 Formats (E4M3 vs E5M2)
* **E4M3:** Best for image generation (Inference). Better detail retention.
* **E5M2:** Better for fine-tuning or training. Slightly more stable but less detailed.

---

## 📺 Support & Community

**DE:** Gefallen euch unsere Workflows? Besucht uns auf YouTube!
**EN:** Do you like our workflows? Visit us on YouTube!

* **Main Channel:** [@murphylanga](https://www.youtube.com/@murphylanga)
* **AI Art & Music:** [@The_Ziggys](https://www.youtube.com/@The_Ziggys)
* **Playlist:** [Comfy UI 2026 Tutorials](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLOlk3DTLbLzSXWrrfV10ptzlj0Xx60AJd)

📢 **DE:** Lasst doch gerne ein Like und einen Kommentar für uns da! Das kostet euch nichts, hilft uns aber enorm dabei, mehr Reichweite zu generieren und euch weiterhin kostenlose Inhalte zu liefern. Vielen Dank für euren Support! ❤️

📢 **EN:** Please leave a like and a comment for us! It costs you nothing but helps us tremendously to gain reach and continue providing free content for you. Thank you for your support! ❤️

---
**VRAM Tip:** If your GPU has less than 12GB VRAM, always prefer **FP8** or **FP4** text encoders to avoid crashes.
